name: kpi-card
title: KPI Card
description: A metric card with a label, a big number, the change since last period and an optional sparkline. Good and bad changes are colored and also spoken.

props.name: value
props.description: The headline number or text. Numbers are formatted with en-US grouping.

props.name: prefix
props.description: Text before the value, such as "$".

props.name: suffix
props.description: Text after the value, such as "%" or " ms".

props.name: delta
props.description: Change since the last period, in percent. Positive is up.

props.name: lowerIsBetter
props.description: Count a falling number as good news, for metrics like errors or cost.

props.name: deltaLabel
props.description: Words after the delta, such as "vs last week".

props.name: trend
props.description: Recent values for a sparkline in the corner, oldest first.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon at the top right. Decorative.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
